title: centaurea cineraria subsp. circae
intro: Centaurea cineraria subsp. circae, commonly known as Silver Dust or Dusty Miller, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant is known for its attractive, silvery-gray foliage that provides a striking contrast to other plants in the garden. The leaves of Centaurea cineraria subsp. circae have been traditionally used in herbal medicine to support digestion and relieve symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome due to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including tannins and flavonoids, exert therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
